Container.Name: DayFront Beta
Container.Overview: Pre-release DayFront image for testing multi-user CalDAV login. Install alongside stable using the isolated default port and appdata paths.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: calendar caldav tasks todo ics self-hosted beta
Container.Changes: Beta test of multi-user CalDAV login with persistent encrypted sessions.
Container.DonateText: Support DayFront development on Buy Me a Coffee
Container.Requires: An accessible CalDAV server. Enter only its URL for the default multi-user flow; DayFront generates and persists a unique login-session secret automatically.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Isolated host port for the DayFront beta Web UI.

Config.Name: CalDAV Server URL
Config.Description: Full HTTP or HTTPS URL of the CalDAV server.

Config.Name: Authentication Mode
Config.Description: Prompts each user for their own CalDAV credentials.

Config.Name: Session Secret File
Config.Description: File where DayFront generates and retains its encrypted-login session key. Change only when using a custom data mapping.

Config.Name: Session Lifetime
Config.Description: Maximum login-session lifetime in hours. The default is 720 hours (30 days).

Config.Name: Container Timezone
Config.Description: System timezone used for container logs and runtime behavior, for example UTC or America/Toronto.

Config.Name: Calendar Display Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used to display and interpret calendar values. Use local, UTC, or an IANA name such as America/Toronto.

Config.Name: Time Display Format
Config.Description: Time display format. Use 12h for AM/PM or 24h for 24-hour time.

Config.Name: Sidebar Open by Default
Config.Description: Set true to open the sidebar when DayFront loads; false starts with the calendar maximized.

Config.Name: Trust Reverse Proxy
Config.Description: Set true only when DayFront is directly behind a trusted proxy that overwrites forwarded headers.

Config.Name: Persistent Session Data
Config.Description: Stores the generated session secret so users remain signed in across updates and restarts.

Config.Name: Advanced Configuration Directory
Config.Description: Optional directory containing config.yaml for advanced settings and external calendar subscriptions.
